# scheduling-tools

Renderers for the Claude Code built-ins `ScheduleWakeup` (header `in 20m — reason` / `stop loop`, prompt inside) and `Monitor` (header: its description; body: command or ws url and result; note: time limit). All input fields are read as optional.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Renders the scheduling built-ins: ScheduleWakeup as 'in 20m — reason' (or 'stop loop') with its prompt inside, and Monitor as its description with the watched command and time limit.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `JsonlViewerTool.Renderer` "ScheduleWakeup" → `ScheduleWakeupToolView`
    - `JsonlViewerTool.Renderer` "Monitor" → `MonitorToolView`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/tool-call.JsonlViewerTool`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/tool-call.ToolCallCard`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens: `ui/tokens/font-family --font-mono`
